author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational log from Windows hosts. NXLog or the Snare agent forwards it in Snare format over syslog to the data collector, the feed of the Sophos Windows Event Log integration. Sysmon events go to Process, Netflow, DNS, FileMod and Registry by event ID, and other Sysmon events stay generic.
notes:
Setup:
- Windows hosts forward the Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational log in Snare format over syslog, through NXLog or the Snare agent, the feed of the Sophos Windows Event Log integration.
- Each parser is a child of the global parser SNARE_Unsupported, the child of Microsoft_Windows_SNARE_Master that takes Snare events no other built-in parser handles.

Saving in the console:
- To add each in Sophos Fusion, choose Add Custom Parser, tick Set Global Parent in Parser Script and keep Parent parser (default): the parent picker lists only your own parsers, never built-in ones.
- Paste the whole file, !PARENT line included; its !SCHEMA line sets the schema, whatever the dialog shows.
- Without that option the save fails with "code contains restricted syntax: !PARENT"; turn the option on in the editor and save again.
- Saved this way in a lab tenant on 2026-10-15, each parser gave the same Run Test results while still disabled.

Field mapping:
- Event 1 goes to Process; 3 to Netflow; 22 to DNS, with the answers and the RCODE; 11, 23, 26, 27, 28 and 29 to FileMod, where 27 and 28 (blocked by Sysmon) have was_modification_allowed false; and 12, 13 and 14 to Registry.
- Other Sysmon events stay generic.
- The Registry schema has no field for the registry event type, image or user, and the DNS schema none for the process, so those stay in original_data.

Time:
- Send times in UTC, as Sophos asks.
- The event time is UtcTime.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in Sysmon's schema 4.91 field order and the Snare and NXLog output formats.

Testing:
- In a lab tenant on 2026-10-15, a child of Microsoft_Windows_SNARE_Master competed with SNARE_Unsupported, and once SNARE_Unsupported took a line it took every later line in the same Run Test, so a sibling got no Sysmon line that followed another Snare event.
- Under SNARE_Unsupported each parser took all of its lines in each of 15 Run Tests.
- Each parser passed Run Test there on 2026-10-15 (169 of 169 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs).
- In Run Test the Snare parent also sets os (Windows) on every line and computer on Process lines, fields the engine stores but the docs' schema tables don't list, so the emulator leaves them out.

Known gaps:
- Older Sysmon releases (schema before 4.81) lack some fields, which stay unset.
